mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS 3-month growth > 0% does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE declines > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% YoY, the real interest rate is negative, signaling accommodative monetary policy and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined condition (FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%) does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the interaction term between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined condition (HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases) does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances, or if the interaction term between HOUST and UNRATE is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS 3-month growth does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances, or if the correlation between PAYEMS growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, when the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.25% in a month, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
